question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.**
solution:
The correct answer is "**have**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given sentence, we need to use '**have**'** **in the sentence.
 
• Have is used with the **pronouns** I, you, we, and they.
 
• Have is always used to indicate the **present tense **in a sentence.
 
• In the given sentence, we notice the pronoun **you **is mentioned before the blank so we will use '**have**' to fill the blank.

Hence, the correct answer is **option 3**.

**The complete passage is: **You must pace your work. What **(1) do** I mean? I'm glad you **(2) asked **that question. We pace our work according **(3) to** the eight-hour workday. If you **(4) have **twelve hours of work in your in-box, for example, you must **(5) compress** that work into the eight-hour day.
